Name: Tunnel 2 Desert
Author: tnt2018
Description:
[size=3]How to Install:
[/size]o Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI
o Download and Extract Content Patcher by Pathoschild
o Download and Extract Tunnel 2 Village
o Load up SDV using SMAPI

[size=3]How do I know if it Worked?[/size]
[size=2]Go to the Bus Tunnel, and walk to the very end. You should be warped to the Desert with the Bus Driving cutscene[/size]

Manifest.Name: Tunnel to Desert
Manifest.Description: Allows you to get to the desert via the tunnel (and vise versa)
